name: Bear Crawl

instructions.description: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimeters off the ground.
Brace the trunk so the back stays flat and the neck remains neutral.
Move forward by stepping one hand and the opposite foot, then alternate sides in a slow crawl.
Lower the knees to the floor to rest when the set ends.

performanceMetrics.notes: Track crawl distance with controlled posture.

variations.variationDescription: A dynamic quadruped progression that adds locomotion and higher demand.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Hover the knees without crawling to regress the movement.

commentsNotes: Keep the hips low but do not let the lower back sag.
Use short steps rather than rushing.
